assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The telemetry is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The arrhythmias or ischemic changes may be contributing to the symptomatic episodes
The denial was based on CO-197
The denial was due to missing precertification
SilverBridge Advantage requires all such diagnostic monitoring services to be pre-approved
The appeal is addressed to SilverBridge Advantage
